promise: Withdraw all US troops from Afghanistan by September 11, 2021
description: Biden announced the withdrawal on April 14, 2021. CENTCOM reported completion in August, before the September 11 target.
evidence: The Defense Department records the April 14 announcement.
CENTCOM's completion account places withdrawal before the promised September deadline.

promise: By the end of the summer, I want 70% of the adult population in the EU to be vaccinated
description: The European Commission recorded 70% of EU adults fully vaccinated on August 31, 2021, before autumn.
evidence: Commission's official timeline dates the milestone August 31, 2021.

review.note: Commission timeline records August 31, not August 25, milestone. February 17 original speech/date and precise September 21 interpretation of 'end of summer' remain unverified.

promise: Endurance electric pickup would begin production in September 2021, with deliveries starting the same month
description: Lordstown's November 16, 2020 update targeted production and initial deliveries in September 2021. Commercial production began in September 2022, and its FY2022 results record the first commercial sales in Q4 2022.
evidence: Lordstown's FY2022 results report three vehicle sales in Q4 2022 and subsequent customer use. Production and initial customer deliveries occurred after September 2021. This rating covers their commencement, not mass production, all reservations, or the planned 500-vehicle batch.
